Nicole Kidman, Kim Kardashian, Katy Perry, Salma Hayek, Cardi B At Balenciaga Couture Show '25; N18G
Stars like Kim Kardashian, Salma Hayek, Katy Perry, Nicole Kidman, Cardi B, and Anna Wintour graced the Balenciaga haute couture show in Paris on Wednesday looking stunning. Most of the celebrities wore black, paying tribute to designer Demna’s final collection for the brand before he heads to Gucci.
